import json,ssl,urllib.request,datetime
url="https://serveriptv.duckdns.org/System/Info/Public"
req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"VivoAPK public service check"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,context=ssl.create_default_context(),timeout=15) as response:
 data=json.loads(response.read(65536))
 result={"check":"public Jellyfin endpoint","timestamp_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"status":response.status,"tls_certificate_validation":True,"version":data.get("Version"),"scope":"public service metadata only","authenticated_playback":False}
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
assert result["status"]==200 and result["version"]
